correctness.rationale: Precisely defined base graphs and induced line graphs are exhaustively encoded by 15 ternary digits. Two independent exhaustive classifiers, depth-first active-path versus indegree-pruning, agree for every nonempty period-entry histogram cell across 3^15 states each (46 and 37 cells), and show exact sharp cutoff 17 versus 12. A separate backtracking group action exhausts all 20 and 120 base automorphisms and, by cubic triangle-free star-triangle reconstruction, the full line-graph groups. All 186 and 150 non-three temporal cycle representatives have verified periods and complete group-orbit partitions. Scripts are embedded and reproducible; no infinite generalization is asserted.

value.rationale: The named GP(5,1)/GP(5,2) pair is the canonical ten-vertex prism/Petersen contrast. A natural graph transformation produces fifteen quartic sites and a massive increase in state-space size while preserving every exceptional non-three orbit count exactly in these two cases. The period-three counts and transients change dramatically, and the 13-versus-3 exceptional geometric-class partition exhibits a sharp new symmetry comparison. Exact complete finite orbit and basin tables provide reproducible dynamical benchmarks beyond routine single small-state arithmetic.
